canDoYue: 你識喺轉機前睇申報表、問幾早去入境處，同大袋喺邊個行李轉盤托運。
canDoEn: Ask about a declaration, a layover, immigration, and the carousel.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you check my declaration before the layover, and tell me which belt to use?
dialogue.glossYue: 中轉之前可唔可以睇我份申報表，話我知用邊條帶？
dialogue.say: Could you check my declaration before the layover, and tell me which belt to use?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Your declaration looks fine, and baggage belt three is on the left.
dialogue.glossYue: 你份申報表冇問題，行李帶三號喺左邊。
dialogue.say: Your declaration looks fine, and baggage belt three is on the left.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with this bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果兩點起飛，我要帶住呢個袋幾早到入境處？
dialogue.say: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with this bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Reach immigration by one. A two o'clock layover needs a bit more time.
dialogue.glossYue: 一點前到入境處。兩點中轉要多啲時間。
dialogue.say: Reach immigration by one. A two o'clock layover needs a bit more time.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Where do I take this heavy bag if immigration is past the carousel?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果入境處喺行李轉盤後面，我將呢個重袋帶去邊？
dialogue.say: Where do I take this heavy bag if immigration is past the carousel?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Take that heavy case over to the carousel. Immigration sits just past the doors.
dialogue.glossYue: 將嗰個重箱拿到行李轉盤。入境處就喺門後面。
dialogue.say: Take that heavy case over to the carousel. Immigration sits just past the doors.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I keep the small bag and check the big one at the far carousel?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以留住細袋，大袋喺遠嗰邊轉盤寄艙？
dialogue.say: Can I keep the small bag and check the big one at the far carousel?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Keep the small case, and check the big bag at that far carousel.
dialogue.glossYue: 得。留住細箱，大袋喺遠嗰邊轉盤寄艙。
dialogue.say: Yes. Keep the small case, and check the big bag at that far carousel.
